subject.title: Feature: Support custom anthropic_beta flags in Bedrock model config

question: Should Bedrock expose a broad `additionalModelRequestFields` or `providerFields` passthrough, a narrower typed `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` option, or no user-configurable beta flags?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding a provider request-field config contract affects OpenClaw's compatibility-sensitive config and provider surface and needs maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
options.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that validates and safely merges request fields, including `anthropic_beta`, without adding a generic core passthrough.

options.title: Add only a narrow beta option
options.body: Support a typed Bedrock `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` path for Claude long-context use while avoiding a general Converse body extension point.

options.title: Decline custom betas
options.body: Keep Bedrock request shaping internal and require first-class provider support for each beta feature instead of user-supplied request fields.

recommendation.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
recommendation.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that validates and safely merges request fields, including `anthropic_beta`, without adding a generic core passthrough.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans provider/plugin boundaries and config contract policy, and `steipete` is the clearest recent routing owner from current Bedrock blame plus adjacent Anthropic GA merge history.
